title: Unsupervised Head Network Personalization for Split Computing via Federated Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.27952v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Split Computing (SC) is a distributed inference method designed for balancing computational load and reducing latency by partitioning a neural network into head and tail networks and deploying them across both a mobile device and a server, respectively. Due to the limited bandwidth and computational power of mobile devices, the head network is often replaced with a neural network that requires lower computational and communication resources. However, it is challenging to prepare a sufficient quantity and quality of labeled data on the mobile device side for training the replacement head network. Furthermore, the data prepared by mobile users often contains sensitive privacy information, making data aggregation difficult. In this paper, we propose a data-efficient head network training method for SC. translated_title: 基于联邦学习的分割计算无监督头部网络个性化
translated_abstract: 分割计算（SC）是一种分布式推理方法，通过将神经网络分割为头部网络和尾部网络，并分别部署在移动设备和服务器上，旨在平衡计算负载并降低延迟。由于移动设备的带宽和计算能力有限，头部网络通常会被替换为需要较少计算和通信资源的神经网络。然而，在移动设备端准备足够数量和质量的标记数据来训练替换的头部网络是具有挑战性的。此外，移动用户准备的数据通常包含敏感的隐私信息，使得数据聚合变得困难。本文提出了一种面向分割计算的数据高效头部网络训练方法。该方法利用联邦学习和知识蒸馏，使用少量非独立同分布且无标签的数据来训练头部网络。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种结合联邦学习与知识蒸馏的数据高效方法，在仅需少量无标签、非独立同分布数据且保护用户隐私的前提下，实现分割计算中头部网络的无监督个性化训练。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a data-efficient method combining federated learning and knowledge distillation to achieve unsupervised head network personalization for split computing using only small amounts of non-IID, unlabeled data while preserving user privacy.
